03 — Featured
Consulting + Community
Ready Block: Earthquake Resilience for West Berkeley
Co-led a full consulting engagement for Berkeley's Office of Emergency Services, targeting Spanish- and Cantonese-speaking residents on 6th–9th streets. Designed a two-phase WHEN model: March CERT training at 997 Cedar St to recruit bilingual promotores, then August National Night Out block activations.

Backed by three empirical anchors: 72% probability of M6.7+ earthquake on the Hayward Fault within 30 years (USGS), highest liquefaction risk in Berkeley from bay fill soils, and 80% of housing losses hitting soft-story wood-frame multifamily buildings (Berkeley LHMP 2024).

To measure behavior change, proposed a UTM-tagged QR code tracking system built in Google's Campaign URL Builder and routed through Google Analytics — translating community engagement into measurable KPIs.
UTM Tracking City of Berkeley
